page.layout: One printed page: a single full-page woodcut illustration of the crucifixion, with a landscape below. No text printed. A blue library stamp lies over the lower right of the image and is not transcribed.
page.notes: Engraving: a crucifix with the crucified Christ, flanked by a city landscape with buildings, a obelisk-like tower, hills and trees. No printed words. The blue circular stamp at lower right is a library stamp and is omitted.
